rows.detail: Acuitus records Sites 1 and 2 at Nowell Lane sold for GBP285,000 as a ground-rent investment over six warehouses. Leeds Sculpture Workshop's current first-party site and active company record confirm operation at Site 2, Unit 2, Nowell Lane. This strongly verifies one demise, but the January 2026 review outcome, ground-rent payment, occupation of the other five warehouses, legal completion, title and exact geometry remain unread.

Acuitus records Matrix House sold for GBP350,000 and let to Portland House Investments Limited until February 2048 at a fixed annual rent. Companies House keeps the legal tenant active and registered at Matrix House but classifies it as non-trading. Current address evidence, including LS1 Print's first-party contact page, confirms multiple operating businesses in the building. The precise unit allocation, tenant-undertenant relationships, fixed-rent payment, legal completion, title and geometry remain unread.

Acuitus records Sites 1 and 2 at Torre Road sold for GBP310,000, with long interests held by MLI No.1 Propco and Al-Murad Management. Al-Murad Management remains active but is registered elsewhere, while current address records and an officer appointment bind Lumo Property activity to Unit 2, Eagle Industrial Estate. These signals support continuing site use but do not prove occupation of both legal sites, the MLI interest, January 2025 RPI review, rent payment, legal completion, title or exact geometry.

Acuitus records a Whitehall Road ground-rent warehouse sold for GBP75,000 under a long peppercorn lease. Current first-party and official records bind Quest Waste and Subscan UDS operations to 126 Whitehall Road, including a 2025 traffic-commissioner operating-centre record. The auction page does not state the postal number, so the physical site match is tight but the exact legal demise is not treated as proven. Peppercorn performance, lessee identity, legal completion, title and geometry remain unread.

Acuitus records the Central Garage interest at Bristol Street and Benson Street sold for GBP43,500 under a long peppercorn lease. Current business and recent garage-directory evidence confirms Beatties or Central Garage continuing at the exact Benson Street location. Current physical use is strongly supported, but peppercorn performance, legal lessee continuity, legal completion, title and exact geometry remain unread.

Acuitus records Site 5B at Armley Road sold for GBP400,000, with B&M and Farmfoods occupying the retail warehouses and FRELIF Armley LLP holding the long interest. Current B&M and Farmfoods store evidence confirms both retailers operating on Armley Road. Current sources use postcode variants different from the auction record, so exact postal binding was retained as a caveat. The February 2026 RPI review, rent payment, FRELIF legal continuity, legal completion, title and geometry remain unread.
Aberaman Surgery in Aberdare, Wales is outside the ready_to_sell_1 England scope. No English candidate, parcel value or canonical row reference was created.

Nationwide Leisure Homes remains active and registered at the exact Unit D432 address, although its accounts are overdue. Option exercise, holding-over, rent payment, withdrawal outcome, title and geometry remain unread.
